viewer.funFact0: People finish forms up to 3x faster when each field is explained in plain language.
viewer.funFact1: Clear translations cut rework and back-and-forth with offices and landlords.
viewer.funFact2: Auto-filled examples help users avoid common mistakes on official forms.
viewer.funFact3: Guided field explanations reduce missed signatures and empty fields.
viewer.funFact4: Smart extraction means fewer manual steps and more time saved.
viewer.funFact5: Consistent formatting makes reviews faster for everyone involved.
